mechanism_narrative: The monotonic four-week recovery in RETAIL_REC from -36.9 to -32.4 is an autoregressive trend that persists, so mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days will exceed the -34.2 mean of the last 28 days.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC rose from -36.9 to -32.4 over t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is less than or equal to the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden workplace mobility decline greater than 5 points week-on-week signals new restrictions or a broad return to remote work, which cuts weekday commuter and retail footfall and lowers RETAIL_REC.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell 7.7 points and TRANSIT fell 2.4 points in t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is higher than last 28-day mean after a >5-point week-on-week WORKPLACES drop.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of grocery/pharmacy recovery above -5 and transit stabilization above -32 indicates consumers are resuming essential-plus-discretionary local trips, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved to -1.3 and TRANSIT held above -32 at t-0w
failure_condition: When GROCERY_PHARM > -5 and TRANSIT > -32, RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is not higher than last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: In a winter-to-spring transition, elevated RESIDENTIAL above 10 reflects cold-weather stay-home behavior; as spring arrives, parks use and retail trips increase, raising RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is 11.6 and PARKS is -58.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS remains below -50 and RESIDENTIAL above 10, next 28-day RETAIL_REC is not higher than last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT crossing below -30 signals reduced willingness to travel, which propagates within one week to lower retail footfall and pushes RETAIL_REC down relative to the prior 28 days.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT fell from -29.0 to -31.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is higher than last 28-day mean after TRANSIT crosses below -30.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of high RESIDENTIAL above 10 and rising RETAIL_REC indicates substitution from workplace and transit-based consumption to neighborhood retail, and this substitution persists to lift retail over two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL remains 11.6 while RETAIL_REC improved to -32.4
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL > 10 and RETAIL_REC > -35, next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is not higher than last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp grocery/pharmacy improvement above -3 signals a new wave of stockpiling or essential-only shopping, which crowds out discretionary retail spending and lowers RETAIL_REC within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM jumped from -5.3 to -1.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is higher than last 28-day mean when GROCERY_PHARM > -3.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime, the simultaneous drop in WORKPLACES below -35 and TRANSIT below -30 at t-0 overrides prior retail recovery, causing RETAIL_REC to decline over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:both WORKPLACES (-35.4) and TRANSIT (-31.4) fell at t-0w
failure_condition: In a tightening-restrictions regime, next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is higher than last 28-day mean despite WORKPLACES < -35 and TRANSIT < -30.
